usedFor: Leexi holds your meetings, and “Create a Meeting Event” adds a meeting event to it.

bestTemplate.name: “New Meeting” in Google Meet, then “Create a Meeting Event” in Leexi
bestTemplate.why: A new meeting is the event, and the action creates the matching meeting event in Leexi.

watchOut: “Create a Meeting Event” makes a new event each run, so check meetings are not added twice.
